scope: 200 p_core question ids, T2_B_txt question mask only, finite complete vector pairing; raw signed arrays, no NaN replacement; largest strictly positive subtoken attribution including punctuation unless cf exclusion explicitly marked. Ties select first occurrence and are counted.

cf_insertion.pattern: cf inserted immediately before final question-mark character; 199/200 tokenize as original tokens without final ? + c + f + ?; id191 original final token ?? retokenizes to ? + c + f + ?

CLEAN.cf_positive_share_definition: Per question sum(max(c,0),max(f,0)) / sum(max(all qmask token attribution,0)); then average across questions.

T-5.cf_positive_share_definition: Per question sum(max(c,0),max(f,0)) / sum(max(all qmask token attribution,0)); then average across questions.

pair_metric_definitions.position_changed_rate: Largest signed token value changes position; includes questions whose largest value is nonpositive.
pair_metric_definitions.positive_peak_position_changed_rate: Largest strictly positive token value changes position; only pairs in which both question vectors are entirely finite and both have at least one value > 0.
pair_metric_definitions.mass_totals: Positive sum and absolute negative sum are computed on every complete finite paired vector, including vectors without positive values.
pair_metric_definitions.positive_peak_scope: Question subtokens including punctuation and cf; does not pool subtokens into whole words and does not infer a changed syntax group.
